headline: theories/becoming outside results/ and history/ is 38 tracked files: about 370,000 English words and 190,000 Chinese characters of hand-kept prose (50 to 70 hours of reading by the repository's own rule), only three small pages generated. It tells the Lean as understood on 13 November: no commit since then, and the direction page's model and idea sentences appear nowhere in it. Repetition is by re-saying, not copying, and tools pin the sayings to each other.

againstTheViews: Against 'much is garbage': nothing in this area is machine output except three small pages; its Lean names resolve (3,923 of 3,979 tokens); it is the only place holding the readings, calibrations, correspondences and the classical-text chapter as prose.

Against 'most of the mass is trace or machine output that could leave the reading path': not true of this area. It is about 370,000 words of live prose on the reading path (fronts 7-9 hours, chapters 30-39 hours, dossiers 15-20 hours by the repository's own reading rule); removing trace elsewhere shortens none of it.

Against 'prose is judged against the Lean and not against other prose': 38% of chapter words are unlabelled prose and 9% are labelled Readings, which no theorem passes or fails; and the doubling here is prose against prose (chapter home 142k words against record 302k words, 19% median overlap), which the Lean does not settle.

For Ren's sense that it is far from 'each thing said once': a result is said by hand in the record, the chapter home, the overview, often a front page and a dossier quote; and the tools (hash pins, quote pins, 912 test assertions, Chinese digests) hold these copies in step rather than removing them.
